唔好意思: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 - I'm sorry (common)
我唔知: ngo5 m4 zi - I don't know
我见咗 Nadal: ngo5 gin3 zo2 Nadal - I met Nadal
我食咗饭: ngo5 sik6 zo2 faan6 - I ate
再嚟: zoi3 lai4 - come again, do it again
我请你食: ngo5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 - I invite you to eat
请帮助佢: ceng2 bong1 zo6 keoi5 - please help her
我请嚟 party?: ngo5 ceng2 lai4 party - (I invite you to a party?)
请去嗰度: ceng2 hoi go dou6 - please go over there
请嚟呢度: ceng2 lai4 ni dou6 - please come over here
请问，你住喺边度: ceng2 man6, nei5 zyu6 hai2 bin1 dou6 - let me ask, where do you live?
请问，点讲__: ceng2 man6, dim2 gong2 __ - let me ask, how to say __
呢个系乜嘢: ni go hai mat ye - (what is this?)
请问，你要__，乜嘢?: ceng2 man6, nei jiu __ hou, mat ye - (let me ask, what do you want __?)
请问，嗰个系乜嘢: ceng2 man6, go2 go3 hai6 mat1 jes - may I ask, that one is what?
呢度系几多人: ni dou hai gei do yan - how many people are here
而家系几点: ji1 gaa1 hai6 gei2 dim2 - now is what time?
佢系边个: keoi hai bin go3 - he is who?
我系多年?: ngo5 hai6 do1 nin - (I am older — many years)
你想饮乜嘢?: nei gui yum mat ye - you want to drink what?
我系比你多年 / 岁: ngo5 hai6 bei2 nei5 do1 nin4 / seoi3 - I am, compared to you, more years / ages
你比我靓: nei5 bei2 ngo5 leng3 - you, compared to me, (are) beautiful
